subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Sierra Tech
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sierra.tech>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Sierra Tech

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about Sierra Tech's goals for embedding LLMs into your customer support flows. Quick recap from our call: 

- Current state: internal search + rule-based routing, average handle time 6.5m, rising deflection workload.
- Desired outcome: reduce average handle time by 20% and automate first-response for top 5 intents.
- Constraints: PII redaction required, on-prem data retention, need SOC 2 evidence.

Immediate next steps I captured:
1) I’ll share the discovery notes and a short technical checklist for your infra team (attached).
2) We can spin up a 2-week sandbox on Dedicated nodes for a proof-of-concept — Marissa (copied) can scope compute.
3) If sandbox looks good, we’ll follow with a pilot SOW and a performance-demo with your SREs.

Ask: Can you confirm the best technical contact for the sandbox (name and email) and whether the SOC 2 questionnaire should go to procurement or security?

I’ve attached the discovery-notes.pdf with detailed notes and the proposed sandbox config. If it helps, I’m available for a 20-min follow-up on Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 47KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps — Sierra Tech

Quick bump — wanted to check whether you had a chance to look over the notes I sent last week.

If priorities have shifted or now isn't a good time, just let me know and I'll adjust our schedule. Happy to circulate a pared-down sandbox option if budget/timing is tighter than expected.

Thanks,
Neha

Hey Alex —

Wanted to close the loop here. We haven’t heard back after the notes + sandbox proposal and I wanted to check in quickly: is this still something you’re exploring for Q3, or should I close out the thread from our side?

Two quick options:
- If it’s a fit: I can book a 20-min sync next week to confirm technical contact and timeline and start the sandbox.
- If it’s not a fit: a one-line reply is totally fine — just want to keep our pipeline clean.

If helpful, I can also propose a lower-cost pilot scoped only for intent classification (no private infra) to accelerate evaluation.

Thanks for the candid update,
Neha Kapoor
